title: 第1章 长春宫的海选第2章 天生灵感
content_zh:
;;
在崎岖泥泞的小路上，一辆牛车摇啊摇。
刚下过雨，一切显得如此清亮透彻，空气中也带着安宁的芬芳。
赶着牛车的是个半百老汉，而牛车上坐着的则是六个从8岁至12岁的童男童女。
“你们到了镇子上以后不要乱跑，乖乖跟着我去拜见仙师，能不能成可就都看这一次了。”
“要是你们里面真有人被长春宫的仙师带回去修行，那是你们的造化，也是我们苏家村的造化。”
老汉语调带着些期盼地说着。
苏白尘就是坐在牛车上的一员，他今年只八岁，是最小的一个了。
虽然说他和其他孩子一样看起来黑不留丢又脏兮兮的，但他眼中的灵动却是最为闪亮，同时神情也是最为沉稳的。
“二叔爷，你说的那长春宫是正经道观吗？”
二叔爷立刻正色道：“那是自然，我们这仙游县九乡三镇可都是在长春宫的庇护下才能安稳度日，否则你们这些小娃娃早就被妖怪给叼走，做成‘娃娃菜’给吃掉啦！”
苏白尘没好气地说：“二叔爷，这种时候你就别给我们讲这种骗小孩子的故事啦！”
二叔爷正说得起劲，听了不由得撇嘴：“你这娃儿最是没劲……不过二叔爷是给你们说正经的，这长春宫的仙师是真有本事的。”
“具体有什么呢，说说呗。”
苏白尘又追问。
他现在的心情颇为复杂。
穿越到这个世界已经八年了。一开始他以为自己重生到了某个朝代，结果这是个和原本历史完全不相干的异世界。
他都准备好了，等自己再长大一点就要开始展露自己的聪慧，好让族里送他去读书，以此来改变命运。
然而……
当他准备实行计划之前，他竟然先被告知有这么个去修仙的机会……

他现在整个人都有种不太真切的恍惚感。
“尘娃儿，你二叔爷没那么多见识，可没办法给你讲出个所以然来。娃儿们，你们只需要知道，等下若是仙师问你话你就好好回答，明白吗？”
一向跟小辈们嬉皮笑脸没大没小的二叔爷忽然严肃了起来。
苏白尘和那些苏家村的小朋友们连忙一起答应。
一路上大家都显得心事重重，没有再多说什么。
而牛车缓缓而行，也是用了两个时辰，终于在午间到达了河口镇。
镇子里已经十分热闹，唯一的街上到处都是叫卖的商贩。
这河口镇就位于一处水路枢纽旁边，往来商旅不少，颇为繁华。
苏家村的小崽子们哪里见过这么繁华的市集，一时间都看花了眼。
苏白尘则只是随便看了两眼就不再关注了，他依然在思考着所谓的长春宫仙师……
先前和二叔爷聊了一下，他已经知道这样的事情其实每隔十年就会发生一次，各地所有6~16岁的孩子都能参加这个选拔。
当然，具体会发生什么二叔爷也是完全不知道。
content_en:
;;
On the rugged and muddy path, an ox cart rocked.
It had just rained, everything seemed so clear and clear, and there was a peaceful fragrance in the air.
The driver of the oxcart was an old man of half a century, and sitting on the oxcart were six boys and girls aged from 8 to 12 years old.
"When you get to the town, don't run around. Just follow me to see the immortal master. Whether you can succeed or not depends on this time."
"If any of you are really taken back to practice by the Immortal Master of Changchun Palace, it will be your fate and the fate of our Sujia Village."
The old man said with some expectation in his tone.
Su Baichen is one of the people sitting on the bullock cart. He is only eight years old and is the youngest one.
Although he looks as dark and dirty as other children, his eyes are the brightest and his expression is the calmest.
"Second uncle, is the Changchun Palace you mentioned a serious Taoist temple?"
The second uncle immediately said seriously: "That's natural. Our three towns in Jiuxiang, Xianyou County, can only live safely under the protection of Changchun Palace. Otherwise, you little babies would have been taken away by monsters and made into 'baby vegetables' to eat!"
Su Baichen said angrily: "Second uncle, at this time, don't tell us such stories to deceive children!"
The second uncle was talking enthusiastically, but he couldn't help pouting after hearing this: "You kid is the most boring... But the second uncle is telling you seriously, this immortal master of Changchun Palace is really capable."
"What are the specifics? Let me tell you."
Su Baichen asked again.
His mood now is quite complicated.
It has been eight years since I traveled to this world. At first he thought he was reborn in a certain dynasty, but it turned out that this was a different world that had nothing to do with the original history.
He is ready. When he grows up, he will start to show off his intelligence so that the clan can send him to study to change his destiny.
However...
Before he was ready to implement his plan, he was actually told that there was an opportunity to cultivate immortality...
He now had an unreal sense of trance.
"Chen baby, your second uncle doesn't have that much knowledge, so he can't tell you the reason. Children, you just need to know that if the immortal master asks you something later, you should answer it well. Do you understand?"
The second uncle, who had always been playful and smiling with the juniors, suddenly became serious.
Su Baichen and the children from Sujia Village quickly agreed together.
Everyone seemed preoccupied along the way and didn't say anything more.
The oxcart drove slowly, and it took two hours to finally reach Hekou Town at noon.
The town is already very lively, and the only street is full of vendors hawking.
This Hekou Town is located next to a waterway hub. There are many business trips and it is quite prosperous.
The kids in Sujiacun had never seen such a bustling market before, and they were all dazzled for a while.
Su Baichen just glanced at it casually and stopped paying attention. He was still thinking about the so-called Immortal Master of Changchun Palace...
I had a conversation with my second uncle before, and he already knew that this kind of thing actually happens every ten years, and that all children aged 6 to 16 everywhere can participate in this selection.
Of course, the second uncle had no idea what would happen specifically.
